```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)

library(sampleSizeCalc)
```

## Installation

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
# From a local source (e.g. this repo)
devtools::install_local("path/to/1_sample_size_determination")
```

## Two independent means

```{r two-means}
res <- sample_size_calculator(
  "twoMeans",
  mean1 = 10,
  mean2 = 12,
  sd = 3,
  alpha = 0.05,
  power = 0.8
)
print(res)
```

## Survival (log-rank)

```{r survival}
res <- sample_size_calculator("survival", hr = 0.7, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8)
print(res)
```

## Two proportions

```{r two-proportions}
res <- sample_size_calculator("twoProportions", p1 = 0.3, p2 = 0.5)
summary(res)
```

## Supported designs

See `?sample_size_calculator` for all design types (e.g. `pairedMeans`, `caseControl`, `diagnosticAccuracySingle`, non-inferiority/superiority/equivalence, AUC comparisons).
